Type: Furniture | Internal ID: piece_xmascrown | Source: Workbench | Season: Yule (Christmas) | Usage: Decoration | Crafting Materials: Pine cone x4, Red jute x1, Finewood x1 | Weak to (x1.5): Chop | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Spirit

Introduction. Yule wreath is a seasonal decorative object. It needs to be built within the range of a Workbench and on a flat, horizontal surface or underside of a surface.

Availability. The Yule wreath cannot be built year-round. It can only be built during the Christmas season, 1 December – 6 January.
